summary: The executive delivers the recommendation and {person} takes up the assumptions behind it in council review.
realLife: Elrich submitted the FY27 proposal in March, and council president Natali Fani-González called for scrutiny of its assumptions.
gates: The executive has a recommended budget due to the council.
weights: A shorter remaining review period gives a late submission greater consequences.
inGame: needs: transmission of the executive budget to council.

turns.what: The executive recalls the draft before council review.
turns.pulledBy: The finance office finds an error in the revenue estimate.
turns.writesBack: The clerk marks the first version withdrawn.

turns.what: A corrected schedule follows the budget submission.
turns.pulledBy: A department spots a missing appropriation table.
turns.writesBack: The council docket links the supplement to the original proposal.
